discussion_comments.comment_body: Addressed in `448d7f11e` — *fix(vcs): reject worktree clone with destination inside source and strip nested .git*. Please take another look.

Fixed in a5422b406b: only the existing ANCESTORS of the destination are canonicalized; the final entry stays lexical, so a symlink there is replaced by the backend rather than followed. `destination_inside_source_keeps_the_final_entry_lexical` covers it.
